profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Back-end engineer, Creative Technologist, Designer. Former New York Times software engineer for the  the digital subscription e-commerce team. Passionate about emerging technologies to create new ways of interaction, connecting the physical and digital world. 

Prior to attending the MFA Design and Technology at Parsons, worked as Industrial and Product Designer developing lighting, furniture and architectural design. 

Before joining the New York times I worked at Spies and Assassins(KBS) as a Product Architect and Full Stack developer. Translating business objectives into design solutions. Focusing on web platforms, digital and physical experiences; developing and creating new products internally.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I am a Software Engineer on the Google Cloud team, where I focus on building and scaling AI as infrastructure. My work on the Trusted Partner Cloud (TPC) has been instrumental in bringing Vertex AI capabilities to our most security-conscious customers. I have contributed to several key projects, including TPC AI, Cloud Wipeout, and the core Trusted Partner Cloud platform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SW Health Platform
During this time, I was a Software Engineer on the SW Health Platform team within the Platforms & Devices PA. I contributed to the development of software for health and wellness products.

Fitbit Platforms and Services
I began my career at Google as a Software Engineer with the Fitbit team. I worked on a variety of projects and teams, including:

Journal & Charting
DSAP Privacy & Trust
Fitbit Core Engineering

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software engineer for the Scores and Screenings team working on micro services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and lead a new payment processor implementation in the NYTImes.com React/Redux checkout flow for users outside the US, by embedding logic in the front-end to call newly developed RESTful endpoints in our subscription platform. Allowing storing new financial instruments, tokenizing of credit cards and subscription purchase. Impacting 120.000 users/month 

Developed a new ETL pipeline for batch processing that updates subscriptions status for 200.000 daily home delivery accounts using DataFlow, optimizing processing time by 300% and reducing cost by $5000/month 

Developed an orchestration micro service between the home delivery and digital subscriptions platforms to facilitate switches back and forth for NYTimes subscribers through RESTful calls 

Helped developed and upgrade the Apple backend receipt verification service with RESTful endpoints for our subscription platform. Including RESTful endpoints, batch jobs and PubSub messaging in order to accommodate new standards for iOS 7+ in order to keep supporting third party subscriptions through iTunes 

Developed and helped launch SubLink (Internal micro service) that reconciles print subscriptions with digital subscriptions, by adding new endpoints to the API service, implementing and improving performance for cron jobs

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain and develop content modules, ecommerce components, and back office tools with focus on high-quality and modular maintainable code

Engineer new services while working along with clients’ IT teams in order to improve platforms to improve flows such as: shopping cart, single sign-on and checkout process

Guide a team of Producers, Product Managers and UX designers in prioritizing features, fixes from a technical standpoint

Conduct and document research for new technologies for front-end, back-end and hardware technologies; as means to incorporate capabilities to the engineering team such as: Windows Services, AR, Sensor data transmission, Capacitive touch, Projection Mapping and Unit Testing

positions.title: Product Architect/Experiential Developer
positions.description:
Build applications/prototypes and experiences using frameworks such as: Processing, openFrameworks, Node.js, p5.js, jQuery, Arduino, RPi
Work with back and front-end developers in order to architect applications and flow of information for platforms and experiences
Translate business objectives into product and experiences from different clients such as Vice, TE, BMW, Simmons, HomeGoods
Conduct research and development of existing or new technologies, in order to build prototypes, help other teams and establish new capabilities
Own the product vision while working closely with UX, Strategy, Creatives and Developers through design and implementation

projects.title: Breath & Brass
projects.description:
Hardware design and hardware/software communication. Arduino, OpenFrameworks. 

“Breath and Brass” visualizes the act of musical performance – both the physicality of the musician’s breathing and the technical nature of the generated music. It newly illuminates the interplay between the instruments and incorporates a more conscious awareness of the musician’s exertion into the audience’s experience.

Working with Poulenc’s Sonata for Horn, Trumpet and Trombone we visualize inhales and exhales together with the notes, volume and speed of the music to reveal the connection between the physicality of music making and the relationships of the sounds and instruments to each other.
